# ANALYSIS: validate-1-2-dte-weekly-options-edge

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The weekly-1 DTE signal (entering at 1 day to expiration instead of 0DTE) captures the same directional edge as the 0DTE BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup but with reduced theta decay and wider spreads, leading to a positive edge per trade. This validates the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate's claim that shifting to 1-2 DTE weekly options preserves the edge while improving the payoff distribution.

## Mechanism

Use the same trigger conditions as BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence) but select options with 1 day to expiration (weekly) and the same strike (ITM-2). Exit at -50% premium stop or +100% TP1 (chandelier trailing) with a 15:50 ET time stop. The signal is evaluated daily; entries occur at the next bar open after trigger confirmation.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (inherited from WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate logic; weekly options premiums similar to 0DTE ITM-2 for sizing).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 225 trades over 2025-Q1 to 2026-Q2 (6 quarters). Selection method: default parameters via kitchen_stage1_runner. Overfit risk: high due to no regime filtering; edge concentrated in 2025-Q2 and 2026-Q1 (see quarterly P&L below).
